sections.title: The 'Why': Explicit vs. Implicit
lecture_lines: Explicit functions express y in terms of x.
Implicit equations relate x and y together.
Circles break the vertical line test.
animations: Create text label 'Explicit Function y = f(x)' in #FFFFFF at center.
Transform 'Explicit' text to 'Implicit F(x, y) = 0' in #FF4500.
Animate fading out explicit label and highlighting implicit label.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Chain Rule Backbone
lecture_lines: Recall the chain rule for derivatives.
Treat y as a function of x.
Differentiate y terms, then append dy/dx.
animations: Highlight variable 'u' in #FFD700 to show intermediate step.
Animate movement of terms through the chain using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/chain.svg].

sections.title: The Step-by-Step Procedure
lecture_lines: Differentiate both sides with respect to x.
Group all terms containing dy/dx together.
animations: Display '1. Differentiate both sides w.r.t x' in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Show '2. Group dy/dx terms' in #00FF00 after 2 seconds.
Display '3. Solve for dy/dx' in #FF6347 at the end [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Applied Visualization: The Orbiting Satellite
lecture_lines: Identify the implicit equation for the orbit.
Calculate the slope at a specific point.
animations: Display ellipse equation x^2/a^2 + y^2/b^2 = 1 in #FFFFFF.
Draw tangent vector at the satellite's position.
Show derivative as slope of tangent line in #00FFFF.
Flash tangent vector to emphasize rate of change.
